data.text/markdown:
Forecasting life expectancy, 2011 to 2023

Build a machine learning model to forecast life expectancy at birth for each country from 2010 to 2023, using only data available up to and including 2010. The calculations are in src/ml/forecast.py, with tests in tests/test_forecast.py. This notebook only reads the saved results from make forecast. It never scores 2011 to 2023 again. Every forecast first removes all data after its start year, and a test replaces every value after 2010 with 999 to prove the forecasts do not change.

1. Choosing the model with practice exams

Each practice exam pretends it is 1990, 1995, or 2000 and forecasts the next 13 years. The model was chosen here, before 2011 to 2023 was scored. Numbers are the average mistake in years, so lower is better.

data.text/html: 216 countries. Best method: ridge_life_exp_only.

data.text/markdown:
2. The final score on 2011 to 2023

The chosen model is gradient boosting with all five datasets and the sudden-drop rule. Bias above 0 means the forecasts were too high on average.
